label: Занятие
description: A 10-sentence usage card for занятие (lesson; occupation).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Занятие' is the neuter nominative subject of 'начинается'. 'В девять' shows the time the class starts.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Занятие' is the inanimate neuter accusative object of 'отменил', identical to the nominative. 'Сегодняшнее' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Занятия' takes the genitive after 'не было' to express absence. 'Сегодня' is an adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К занятию' uses the dative after 'к' with 'готовиться' to mean preparing for. 'Студенты' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Занятием' is the instrumental required by 'гордится'. 'Любимым' agrees in the neuter instrumental, meaning a favourite pursuit.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На занятии' uses the prepositional after 'на' to show location. 'Студентов' is genitive after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Занятие' is nominative as the predicate noun naming a pursuit. 'Любимое' agrees in the neuter, and 'чтение' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Занятия' is the neuter nominative plural subject of 'прошли'. 'Успешно' is an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'занятия'. 'Студенты' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Занятие' is nominative as the predicate noun after 'было'. 'Полезное' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
